subject: Request: legal read + exhibit alignment for NovaHealth MSA/Order Form
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: legal read + exhibit alignment for NovaHealth MSA/Order Form

Team —

Attached is the preliminary Order Form we received from NovaHealth (procurement) and a short list of scope questions I flagged after the commercial call yesterday. We need a fast legal read and an initial pass at Exhibit A (service boundaries + hosting residency) so we can give them a clean counter within 3 business days.

Quick context: NovaHealth is evaluating a Dedicated deployment with a multi-region requirement (US + EU) and has asked for standard SLA language plus tighter data residency notes in Exhibit A. Commercial is asking whether we can (a) accept their Order Form as-is pending a few clarifications, or (b) propose our template with limited redlines.

Asks (short):
- Kimberly: run a prioritization pass on the Order Form clauses (liability, termination for convenience, residency carveouts). Flag anything that needs legal ops or S3 evidence.
- Marissa: help map the billing lines in the order form to our pricing matrix and confirm seat/commit quantities — they listed "up to 40 concurrent seats" which is fuzzy.
- David: please pre-check whether the proposed multi-region residency request triggers any export/control or residency policy risks we should highlight.

Attachments: NovaHealth_OrderForm_v0.3.pdf (order form stub), ExhibitA_ServiceBoundaries.xlsx (initial draft from prospect).

Timebox: I told commercial we'd aim to reply by end-of-day Monday (2025-06-09). If legal needs more runway please advise immediately.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: legal read + exhibit alignment for NovaHealth MSA/Order Form

Sergio —

Thanks, I reviewed the Order Form PDF quickly and have these initial notes (high level):

1) Liability & Indemnity: the counterparty left the limitation of liability blank and inserted a reference to "mutual indemnities" with broad carveouts for third-party claims. We should prepare a short fallback we can accept for Dedicated — I recommend a $5M cap for this PoC / early-deployment deal, but will confirm with legal counsel.

2) Termination for Convenience: they have a 30-day termination for convenience clause with no liquidated damages. Commercial may accept a 60-day window; recommend we keep the right to invoice committed usage for the remainder of the billing period.

3) Data Residency: Exhibit A asks for US+EU residency but lists "US East" and "EU" without specifics. If they need EU residency but want Redwood-managed hosted instances in EU, we need an explicit residency SLA and region mapping.

4) Security Evidence: they requested SOC2 and access to audit logs; we can provide SOC2 report and redact CII if needed. I will pull the last SOC2 snapshot and mark any gaps against their checklist.

Open questions for the commercial thread before I start redlines:
- Can commercial confirm whether the 40 "concurrent seats" is a hard limit or an estimate? (Marissa)
- Do we have to commit to specific cloud provider(s) in Exhibit A? If so, which region names should we call out? (David)

I can do the first redline pass on the Order Form and draft an Exhibit A template by EOD tomorrow if there are no blockers.

-Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Alice Tran <alice@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 12:01:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Request: legal read + exhibit alignment for NovaHealth MSA/Order Form

Alice —

Looping you in on our internal intake so we can align on two quick clarifications before Kimberly drafts comments:

1) Seats: you listed "up to 40 concurrent seats" in the order form. Can you confirm whether "40" is a committed minimum, an estimated peak, or a hard concurrency cap that would block new users?

2) Residency: your Exhibit A references "EU" as a region. For compliance we need the exact residency target (e.g., EU-West (Frankfurt) or EU-Central (Amsterdam)). Can you confirm a preferred EU region or whether you need us to guarantee replication into multiple EU zones?

We'd also appreciate the signed contact person for billing (name + email) so we can put them on the order form and generate the billing schedule.

I copied Marissa and Kimberly; once we have these answers Kimberly will circulate an annotated Order Form with a suggested Exhibit A. If that works, we'll aim to get a redline back by Monday.

Best —
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Request: legal read + exhibit alignment for NovaHealth MSA/Order Form

Thanks Sergio —

Answers below:

1) Seats: 40 is an estimated peak/concurrency we expect in Q4 after rollout. It is not a committed minimum. We can agree to a committed baseline of 20 seats for the first 12 months and a soft cap at 40. If you prefer, we can put that in the order form as "20 committed, scale to 40 based on usage".

2) Residency: We would like EU-West (Frankfurt) as the EU target region. We do NOT require multi-zone replication across EU regions, but we do need assurances that all EU data at rest remains in EU West unless otherwise requested.

Billing contact: James Holt <james.holt@novahealth.com> (Finance Manager).

I'm attaching the Order Form PDF we filled out (OrderForm_NovaHealth_v0.3.pdf) — the file includes the billing contact and the seat numbers noted above. Please confirm receipt and expected timeline for counter.

Regards,
Alice Tran
Senior PM, Platform
NovaHealth
alice@novahealth.com
